official_definition: {During Seal} Bombardment - (When Attacks) Reveal the top two cards on your deck. For each spirit on family "God-King"/"Ten Crown" among them, send one opposing Life to the Reserve. Afterwards, add the revealed cards to your hand.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Bombardment] or [Bombardment: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Bombardment]", "give [Bombardment]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
